steps.title: Define app metadata
steps.description: Specify the application name, package, and unique ID for the project.

steps.title: Configure top-level Gradle build file
steps.description: Set up the main build configuration for the Android project, including repositories and plugin versions.

steps.title: Configure app-level Gradle build file
steps.description: Define application-specific build settings such as namespace, SDK versions, and remove disallowed dependencies.

steps.description: Declare app components, permissions, and fundamental app characteristics in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Create main layout for calculator UI
steps.description: Design the graphical user interface for the calculator, including the display area and button grid.

steps.title: Implement display TextView
steps.description: Add a TextView component to show current input and calculation results.

steps.description: Arrange number, operator, and function buttons using a GridLayout for a standard calculator layout.

steps.title: Implement calculator logic in MainActivity.java
steps.description: Write the Java code to handle user interactions and perform arithmetic calculations.

steps.title: Handle number and decimal input

steps.title: Implement arithmetic operations
steps.description: Code methods for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, including error handling for division by zero.

steps.title: Add clear, sign change, and percentage functions
steps.description: Implement special calculator functions like clearing all input, toggling positive/negative sign, and calculating percentages.

steps.title: Configure Java 8 compatibility
steps.description: Ensure the project is set to compile and target Java 8 for source compatibility.

steps.description: Optimize the APK size by excluding specific resource files during the build process.

steps.title: Update assets/app-meta.json
steps.description: Ensure that the app metadata file in the assets folder contains the correct app name, package name, and app ID for runtime access.

steps.title: Building Calculator
steps.description: Compile and package the Android application.
